description: Election Commission - Election to elect the members of Parliament will be held on 20th June, 2020
reasoning: This gazette content specifically announces the rescheduling of parliamentary elections from 25th April 2020 to 20th June 2020 for all electoral districts in Sri Lanka. It contains an official order under the Parliamentary Elections Act and is issued by the Election Commission, making it clearly about electoral processes and scheduling, which falls under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
